_note: English for data/models.json until skytrain/tools/gallery.py writes it. Missing keys fall back to Japanese.

mk1.line: Running since 1985. Short, boxy body in the current TransLink livery.

mk2.line: Rounded nose and a large windscreen. Since 2002.

icet_411.title: 411 (7 cars)
icet_411.line: Standard livery: red stripe, “ICE” lettering and the DB logo on the nose.

icet_415.title: 415 (5 cars)
icet_415.line: Same shape as the 411; only the numbers differ.

icet_green.title: Green stripe
icet_green.line: 2019–2022. The front of the stripe is green, with label and plug marks.

icet_oebb.line: The three sets used by Austrian Federal Railways: DB livery with ÖBB marks.

icet_td.title: ICE TD (DB)
icet_td.line: The diesel Class 605. Looks the same as the 411 from outside.

icet_dsb.title: ICE TD (DSB)
icet_dsb.line: Livery from the lease to Danish State Railways, navy around the windows.

airo.line: New Seattle–Vancouver coaches, in service since September 2026.

ave102.title: AVE 102 “Pato”
ave102.line: Spanish high-speed train with a duck-bill nose.

allegra.title: Allegra (Rhaetian Railway)
allegra.line: Three-section articulated unit on Swiss mountain lines. Since 2010.

frecciarossa.title: Frecciarossa 1000
frecciarossa.line: Italian high-speed train ETR 400, in the all-red livery used since 2022.

maglev.title: Shanghai Maglev
maglev.line: Wheel-less Transrapid linking the airport and the city since 2004.

vandebharat.title: Vande Bharat
vandebharat.line: Indian high-speed EMU in the saffron and grey livery introduced in 2023.

bus49_front.title: Route 49 bus (front)
bus49_front.line: Front half of the TransLink XD60 articulated bus.

bus49_rear.title: Route 49 bus (rear)
bus49_rear.line: Rear half of the same bus. Couple the two to run them.
